QuestInfo.name: Memories of the Past
QuestInfo.0: The Elven fountainhead... Coming here brings back memories of a peaceful time, before the Black Mage...
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce was bright, but she was just a kid. A kid who didn't always know what to do or how to act around her elders...
QuestInfo.2: Athena Pierce was bright, but she was just a kid. A kid who didn't always know what to do or how to act around her elders... And now she's a Bowman Job Instructor, beloved by everyone. Unbelievable.

1.0: Your Highness...\r\n#L0##bSo this is where you were hiding. Astilda was worried about you, Athena. Why did you come here without telling anyone?#l\n#k
1.1: Th-they say you're leaving! It's not true, right?\r\n#L0##bIt IS true, Athena. I need to go with them...#l\n#k
1.2: You're not going to fight the Black Mage, are you?\r\n#L0##bI am. I'm going to meet this Black Mage everyone is talking about, and I'm going to make him stop hurting people.#l\n#k
1.3: Don't go! What if you get hurt?!\r\n#L0##bDon't worry! I'm going with my friends, and they're all strong, like me. We'll be fine.#l\n#k
1.4: You're lying! I heard the Black Mage is so strong he could, like, reorganize the whole map just by snapping his fingers! Please don't go!\r\n#L0##bI have no choice...#l\n#k
1.5: Can't you just send someone else? You're the ruler of the Elves! Who'll lead us if you're gone?!\r\n#L0##bThat's exactly why I HAVE to go! If the Black Mage isn't stopped, there may not be any Elves left to lead! #l\n#k
1.7: I can't let you go alone, Your Highness! Who'll keep you safe?\r\n#L0##bTh-that's...that's okay, Athena.#l\n#k
1.8: I'm going with you, no matter what!
